## Technical Focus Areas
- **LLM Fine-Tuning:** PEFT, QLoRA, CoT/TiR datasets, Phi-4 optimization, contrastive learning.
- **Autonomous AI Agents:** Agentic loops with parallel tool-use, BFS/DFS decoders, consensus-based voting, long-running orchestration.
- **Model Efficiency:** Mixed-precision quantization (GPTQ Int6), Cross-Sparse Attention (XSA), EMA weight smoothing, extreme compression.
- **Test-Time Adaptation:** Test-Time Training (TTT) strategies for solving novel abstract puzzles (ARC-AGI).
- **RAG Systems:** Retrieval-augmented generation pipelines with semantic search and source attribution.
- **MLOps:** High-availability serverless backends on GCP with aggressive cost-cutting logic.
